notes.title: The Expedition Update v1.42
notes.notes:
Yep! The Expedition is now on Medal and now supports Auto-Clipping powered by Medal!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560812/07bfa108a78d815490f3cda7a3b52cde8bef42b0.png"]

(not a promotion but you should download medal!)
CHANGES:
Added Auto-Clipping in the some scenarios:

Player Death

Chase Ends

Jumpscares

 Endings

Added "The Expedition" on Medal (thanks to the support team!)
FIXES:
Fixed the Ladder on the last level's material not setting properly

Fixed several bugs relating to interactions

Theres not too much else aside from some backend optimizations, due to the fact im working on quite a lot at the moment :)

notes.title: v1.12 Version out!!
notes.notes:
I'm glad to announce that the new The Expedition update is live right now!

the new update adds content and also fixed some bugs that were too long lived.



Changes:

Added Main Menu (by extension extras menu, status, random camera positions etc.)

Added 2 Achievements (Fell of the path & a secret achievement)

Added Tutorial when you first start the game

Made the chests more biased towards giving you batteries

Made the chests 1 second search time instead of 2 seconds

Fixes:

Fixed first ten soft-lock death loop

Fixed second ending killing player randomly

Fixed several movement issues

Fixed an issue where you could somehow clip out of bounds in the first area

Several other fixes i cant remember ;-;



Shoutout to ma boy Ejahmix for playing my game

(go follow him he's an underrated streamer)



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45560812/a31b8470d0928219c0a484e23aa4691c21d44326.png"]
